scope: Prospective only with respect to new ESM associations; historical results already known

features.evo2_primary_AA_score: frozen median experimental-codon ALT-minus-REF local53; no sign flip
features.gemme_primary: raw gemme_norm_combi / normPred_evolCombi; no sign flip
features.esm1v_ensemble: arithmetic mean of five masked-marginal ALT-minus-WT log probabilities

ESM.scope: 28 positions, all canonical AA probabilities in same forwards; no new Evo2 calls

masks: one-to-one keyed finite intersection of all three predictors and endpoint; identical nested model masks; no imputation

spearman.summary: median signed within-position rho on common estimable positions
spearman.difference: median position-level paired difference, not difference of medians

lopo.preprocessing: training-only means and population SD; constant scale=1, flagged
lopo.Q2_denominator: fold-training-mean squared errors; NA exactly zero or nonfinite; no outcome-selected epsilon

uncertainty.draws: physical positions with replacement within hotspot; original eligible counts retained
uncertainty.raw_replacement: same draws if same eligible positions; otherwise paired sensitivity intersection recorded explicitly

influence: delete each physical position from entire new analysis and rebuild LOPO; all endpoints and raw/replacement; no selected exclusions
HS2_exclusion: remove all HS2 positions from train and test and rebuild LOPO
author_replacement: only V641W/L642K four aggregate fitness values; recompute all D-C; same 435 identities, no replicate copying
claim_limits: no superiority from pointwise interval exclusion
HS2_continuous: BLOCKED_INPUT unless independently documented source gate passes before new supplemental protocol and any ratio

HS2_support_scores.candidate: theoretical H490/208 AA groups including absent support
HS2_support_scores.Evo2_summary: median existing H-panel local53 codon scores within AA group, distinct from primary
HS2_support_scores.endpoint: T0-HC codons / designed exact codons; PRE separate
HS2_support_scores.metric: signed within-position Spearman; common paired estimability; same conditional resampling convention
HS2_support_scores.interpretation: exploratory descriptive; no independent binomial trials or survivor435-only conditioning
